nodes.title: Turn meeting conversations into written artifacts without retyping
nodes.quote: The summaries pile up in my inbox. Nobody goes back to read them, and they never reach the PRD.

nodes.title: AI meeting notes are unstructured, so PMs reshape them by hand
nodes.quote: I copy the summary into a doc and then spend half an hour turning it into something a teammate can use.

evidence.quote: Zoom's summary lists action items well, but it has no idea which product outcome we were discussing.
